content: आग्रहः .²1 Seizing, taking. .²2 Attack. .²3 Determination, strong attachment, persistence, insisting (स्नेह, अभिनिवेश); चलेऽपि काकस्य पदार्पणाग्रहः Naiṣadha; <ls>Dk. 176</ls>; also <ls>Malli.</ls> on <ls>Ku. 5. 7</ls>. .²4 Favour, patronage. .²5 Surpassing, surmounting. .²6 Moral power, courage.
